what: Temporal CLI dev-server binary selected by SDK CachedDownload version default
offline: Set GOOBERS_TEMPORAL_CLI to an existing compatible Temporal executable. internal/temporaltest.StartDevServer sets SDK ExistingPath and clears CachedDownload; it does not fall back to network if that executable fails.

what: Go modules, pinned go-run tools and automatically selected Go toolchains
from: Configured GOPROXY (default proxy.golang.org, with storage.googleapis.com redirects)
Direct VCS origins when GOPROXY permits direct
offline: Provision a local file GOPROXY with all selected modules, version lists and metadata, plus cached checksum verification data. Put a compatible Go on PATH and set GOTOOLCHAIN=local. GOPROXY=off alone can fail even for cached go-run tools because their deprecation/version metadata lookup is disabled; a warm source tree alone is not sufficient.

what: Portal package-lock.json dependencies; npm exec can also acquire missing tools
from: Registry selected by npm configuration (repository defaults to registry.npmjs.org)
offline: Prewarm npm's cache for the exact lockfile and set npm_config_offline=true. Registry redirection alone is not an offline guarantee.

what: npm vulnerability advisory data (network access even with installed packages)
offline: no-offline-path: the mandatory portal-audit gate needs a reachable advisory service; warmed package caches do not replace it.

what: Chromium revision selected by the installed playwright-core browsers.json
from: Playwright browser CDNs (cdn.playwright.dev and configured download-host overrides)
offline: Preinstall the exact Chromium revision and completion marker into PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH. resolvePortalPlaywrightSkip validates the revision/marker before skipping the installer, including read-only baked caches.

what: Pinned golangci-lint installer script and release binary used by the hosted composite action, with a Go module proxy fallback
offline: no-offline-path: the hosted setup action invokes curl unconditionally unless the pinned version is already on GOPATH/bin. Exhausting the release download falls back to go install from the configured GOPROXY, which is the separately declared go-modules acquisition and no more offline than it is. Local make ci instead requires golangci-lint already on PATH.

what: Pinned external action code, runner caches/artifacts, and toolchains provisioned by setup actions
from: github.com and GitHub Actions artifact/cache services
Action-specific Go, Node and Java distribution endpoints
offline: no-offline-path: hosted jobs depend on GitHub and opaque external action implementations. These are bootstrap dependencies, not a promise that an action's transitive network behavior has been statically audited.

what: Linux shared libraries required by the Chromium build (--with-deps)
offline: no-offline-path: the hosted Playwright installation step requests --with-deps and has no explicit offline OS-package provisioning switch. A browser cache alone does not satisfy this dependency.

what: Declared integration executables and native bubblewrap packages, including transitive OS dependencies
offline: no-offline-path for the full set: integration has a restored .deb archive fast path, but a miss and the separate sandbox installation still reach apt mirrors.

what: Java fixture dependencies and Maven plugins
from: Repositories selected by the fixture POM and Maven settings (normally Maven Central)
offline: no-offline-path in the hosted warming step: its dependency resolution remains online. A prewarmed Maven local repository with an explicitly offline Maven invocation can support an adopter's integration run.
sites: .github/workflows/ci.yml#dependency-cache-warm/Warm the Maven repository for the Java fixture gaggle:maven-packages

what: GNU Make package for the hosted Windows build
from: Configured Chocolatey package sources and package-script download endpoints
offline: no-offline-path: the Windows job runs choco install without a local package-source override. Native local go run ./test/ci does not require Make.

what: Kubernetes API server and etcd binaries selected by ENVTEST_K8S_VERSION
from: setup-envtest release index and controller-tools envtest release assets on GitHub
offline: Set ENVTEST_INSTALLED_ONLY=1 to select installed matching assets and fail without downloading on a miss. To use an explicit preprovisioned directory, additionally set ENVTEST_USE_ENV=1 and KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS. These environment controls are read by the selected setup-envtest tool and inherited by Make; provisioning the setup tool's own Go modules is a separate acquisition.

what: Go vulnerability database records consumed by govulncheck, independently of its Go module download
offline: Mirror a complete, trusted database snapshot locally and override the Make GOVULNCHECK command with the pinned tool plus -db file:///absolute/database/path. The pinned v1.6.0 tool uses -db, not GOVULNDB. Keep the snapshot current; an empty database is not an acceptable substitute for the vulnerability gate.

what: Kubernetes JSON schemas fetched by kubeconform while validating rendered deployment resources
offline: Preprovision the complete schema set and override the Make KUBECONFORM command with the pinned tool plus -schema-location /absolute/registry/template. Omit default/HTTP locations to prevent fallback; missing local schemas must fail validation rather than skip resources.

what: NuGet packages and restore metadata used by the opt-in dotnet-service integration fixture (GOOBERS_DOTNET_E2E)
from: NuGet sources configured by the SDK/project (normally api.nuget.org and its package CDN)
offline: no-offline-path in the shipped fixture: dotnet test performs restore and no offline-only source configuration is supplied. Preinstalled SDK or NUGET_PACKAGES cache alone is not a guarantee that restore/audit metadata will not contact a source. This test is opt-in, not part of ordinary make ci.
